purpose.title: Guild Raids
purpose.content: This page will combine your synchronized guild data with Guild Raid planning tools.

access.title: Guild access
access.content: Complete each prerequisite shown here. Ready guilds move directly into the Guild Raids workspace.

status.title: Guild Raid status
status.content: Your guild's current boss, HP, tier progress, and prime modifiers — synced automatically when the page loads if the data is over an hour old, or refreshed anytime on demand.

resources.title: Your raid resources
resources.content: Your synced raid and bomb tokens, with when the next one becomes available.

exactMetaDesktop.title: Exact Meta readiness
exactMetaDesktop.content: Curated exact lineups for the active boss, each hero's investment-readiness percentage, and the team's combined score, shown side by side.

exactMetaMobile.title: Exact Meta readiness
exactMetaMobile.content: Team readiness comes first here — expand a card for Comps and source.

navigation.title: Dailies navigation
navigation.content: Move between the daily planners here.

schedule.title: Today's schedule
schedule.content: Raid these campaign nodes with today's available energy. Bonus raids next to it list what is worth raiding if energy is left.

campaignEvent.title: Active campaign event
campaignEvent.content: Shows the campaign event detected from your synced progress, and when it ends — only that event's nodes can be raided today. An unconfirmed end time is the game's projected schedule, not a guaranteed one, so no countdown is shown until it's verified.

energyUsage.title: Daily energy usage
energyUsage.content: Shows how much of your real daily energy you've already spent today across your account, even above 100%.

todaysAttempts.title: Today's attempts
todaysAttempts.content: Every real raid you've made today, account-wide — whether it still has attempts left or has hit its cap.

filters.title: Raids Filters
filters.content: Limit Today and Bonus Raids to the campaign locations you want, for example only 5-slot Elite nodes or a specific enemy faction. The badge shows how many filters are active.

quickFilters.title: Quick filters
quickFilters.content: Switch today's plan for a day. Fewer raids uses the locations that need fewer raid tickets for the same materials. Bottlenecks farms the slowest materials across all goals first. Plan and Goals dates are not affected.

onslaught.title: Onslaught
onslaught.content: Today's Onslaught tokens, by unit: the runs are shared across your goals in priority order, the same way Plan > Schedule spends them.

summary.title: Whole-plan summary
summary.content: These totals cover every planned day, beginning with Today. If a goal has a requirement with no supported source, the completion date stays unavailable and the blockers are listed below.

filter.title: Unit filter
filter.content: Pick a unit to dim everything else across every day, then jump to its first or last day.

days.title: Raid days
days.content: Each day card lists the upgrades to farm as a grid. Hover or tap an upgrade for its units and nodes; finished upgrades sit under "Raided", planned shop purchases under "Shops" and Onslaught runs under "Onslaught". Drag or swipe to scroll through the days.

switcher.title: Choose an event
switcher.content: Shows the current event by default. Open any other upcoming or past Home Screen Event here, or step through them with the arrows. Your choice stays in the page address, so you can reload or share it.

status.title: Event status
status.content: The shown event's name and when it ends, starts or ended, and whether it earns points from campaign raiding.

details.title: Event details
details.content: What the event rewards and boosts, read from the game data, and the reward tier your power level and roster put you in.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.content: Every milestone's points and reward. The last cell repeats endlessly after the final milestone.

projection.title: Points projection
projection.content: The Arena, Onslaught and Salvage Run tokens you can still use before the event ends, what each must average to reach the final milestone, and where your own averages land. Edit the averages; they are remembered for this event. Tournament Arena tokens are not synced, so enter yours when the event scores there.

teams.title: Event teams
teams.content: Teams to play while the event runs, built from your strongest characters with the ones that score first. Onslaught and Salvage Run get a team per alliance; on a phone, pick the mode above the teams. Any rule about which enemies count is stated here.

farm.title: Farm list for event points
farm.content: Where to raid today to earn event points while feeding your goals, filled to the energy you have left today.

top.title: Best locations
top.content: The locations that earn the most event points per raid and per energy, regardless of your goals.

header.title: The event
header.content: The featured hero, their alliance and when the event ends. Before it starts, the tab previews the next event.

tracker.title: Your missions
tracker.content: Pick the mission you are on and type the progress of its two objectives. Progress is saved in this browser for this event only.

allMissions.title: All missions
allMissions.content: Open the full list of missions. Each one expands to its tips.

raids.title: Campaign raids
raids.content: Where to raid today for the current mission's campaign objective, cheapest energy first, after the raids already on today's plan. The summary below counts the campaign battles left over the whole event.

team.title: Mission team
team.content: A team from your roster for missions that restrict the lineup or need the featured hero.

tokens.title: Tokens needed
tokens.content: Arena, Guild Raid, Onslaught and Salvage Run battles the remaining missions need, against your tokens now.

pace.title: Event pace
pace.content: Enter your event points and rank, and optionally what you hold now, to project currency, chest tier and shards, and pick a target to see the points a day it needs.

paceSummary.title: Pace at a glance
paceSummary.content: Your points, where they end up and the step they reach. Tap Details to enter points, rank and what you hold, and to pick a target.

header.title: The quest
header.content: The featured hero, who must play every battle, the factions you may deploy and the time left. Pick another quest to browse its battles.

summary.title: Your score
summary.content: Your points out of 8,800, the crates they open and the battles where points are still left.

battles.title: Battles by tier
battles.content: The 17 battles from Common to Mythic with their slots, bonus objectives, drop and points. Select one to see it.

entry.title: Your best attempt
entry.content: Enter medals, Lightning Victory points and the bonus objectives you met. Only your best attempt counts.

detail.title: Battle detail
detail.content: The board, enemies with their level, the rarity cap, and the drop with what your goals need of it.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.content: The crates your score opens, the featured hero's shards from medals and what they unlock, with a shortcut to plan them as a goal.

tokens.title: Attempts
tokens.content: Enter your tokens now to see whether your attempts cover the battles still below their maximum.

team.title: Suggested team
team.content: Your featured hero plus the strongest units that keep the bonus objectives, with power at the tier's cap. Badges show which objectives the team meets.

estimate.title: Clear estimate
estimate.content: Whether your team beats the battle's power at the tier cap, with and without the bonus objectives. Rows show the verdict; the summary projects your final points.

blockers.title: Some goals cannot finish yet
blockers.partial: Obtainable work is scheduled; the rest has no supported source, so there is no completion date.
blockers.none: Nothing is obtainable yet, so nothing is scheduled and there is no completion date.

raidsFilters.title: Raids Filters
raidsFilters.description: Limit which campaign locations Today, Bonus Raids and the HSE tab may use. Plan and Goals are not affected.

filteredOut.title: Raids Filters removed some materials
filteredOut.materials_one: {{count}} material has no allowed location with these filters.
filteredOut.materials_other: {{count}} materials have no allowed location with these filters.
filteredOut.pinned_one: {{count}} goal is pinned to a location excluded by your Raids Filters. Reset the filters or change the pin.
filteredOut.pinned_other: {{count}} goals are pinned to a location excluded by your Raids Filters. Reset the filters or change the pin.

help.fewerRaids: When several locations cost the same energy per item, raid only the ones with the highest energy per battle. Same materials for the same energy, in fewer raids. Useful when you're low on raid tickets.
help.bottlenecks: Ignore goal priority today: combine the remaining materials of all goals and farm the slowest ones first, usually Legendary materials. Useful for starting long farms early.

note.fewerRaids: Fewer raids: tied locations with more energy per battle are used, so the same materials take fewer raids.
note.bottlenecks: Bottlenecks: today's raids farm the slowest materials across all goals first. Plan and Goals dates still follow goal priority.

status.earnsPoints: Earns event points from campaign raids: 3 per matching enemy, 5 on Elite nodes.
status.noRaidPoints: This event does not earn points from campaign raiding.
status.noneRunning: No Home Screen Event is running right now.
status.noneScheduled: No Home Screen Event is scheduled.
status.error: Event data could not be loaded. The rest of Dailies is unaffected.

preview.title: Preview: {{name}} is not live yet
preview.body: These lists use the rules of this upcoming event and the energy you have left today. Nothing here earns event points until the event starts {{when}} ({{date}}).

raids.title: Farm list for event points
raids.note: Locations that earn event points and feed your goals, chosen from your whole plan. It picks point-earning locations even where a cheaper location without points exists, so it can cost more energy per item than Today.

empty.noGoals: You have no active goals, so there is nothing to farm.
empty.noEnergy: There is no energy left today for any of these locations.
empty.nothingContributes: No location that earns event points drops a resource your goals still need. See the best locations below for where to raid for points.
empty.filtered: No location matches your Raids Filters.

top.empty: No unlocked location left to raid earns event points.
top.filteredEmpty: No location matches your Raids Filters.

projection.title: Points projection
projection.error: Your synced tokens could not be read. The event details are unaffected.
projection.allLocked: None of the modes this event scores in is unlocked yet: {{modes}}.
projection.milestonesDone: of {{total}} milestones done (each repeat after the last counts as one)
projection.progressHint: Copy both from the event in the game: points restart at 0 after each milestone. Your sync does not include them.
projection.needAverage: Enter an average for every mode to see the projected points.
projection.toNextRepeat: {{points}} pts to the next endless reward
projection.repeats_one: {{count}} endless reward beyond the final milestone
projection.repeats_other: {{count}} endless rewards beyond the final milestone

notes.summed: {{mode}}: {{count}} point rules apply, so “{{perUnit}}” assumes each one matches all of them.
notes.enemyRestricted: Only some enemies count (see the event details), so enter your average of kills that count.
notes.battles: Battle modes score once per token, assuming a full line-up of five characters from one faction: points per character plus the full line-up bonus.
notes.manualTokens: {{modes}} tokens are not synced from the game: enter how many you will spend during the event.
notes.campaign: Campaign raids also earn points in this event; they are planned in the farm list below.
notes.syncedAt: Tokens from your sync {{when}}, assuming you spend them before your buckets fill up.
notes.syncUnknown: Your sync time is unknown, so tokens are counted from now, assuming you spend them before your buckets fill up.
notes.upcoming: Tokens assume full buckets when the event starts and that you spend them before they fill up.

teams.title: Event teams
teams.description: Power teams for the modes this event scores in, led by the characters that score. Onslaught and Salvage Run get one team per alliance.
teams.anyUnit: Any unit scores, so this is your strongest team.
teams.broadened: Fewer than five of these characters score for the event, so your strongest others fill the team.
teams.broadenedNone: None of these characters score for the event, so this is your strongest team.
teams.broadenedFaction: Line-up points need a full team of one faction, and you own fewer than five {{faction}} characters, so your strongest others fill the team.

hints.excluded: Only kills of non-{{enemies}} enemies count.
hints.allowedExcluded: Only kills of {{enemies}} enemies that are not {{excluded}} count.
